comment: The bar groups brush, stroke and view and names the rotation. The bar at 1920 by 1080 and at 1280 by 800, then with the second row on at 1280 and at 1920, where the rotation, the symmetry three and the stabiliser toggle move under the menus. A thin rule in the border colour with a gap either side stands between two shown neighbours whose groups differ, brush and view after Opacity, view and stroke after the rotation's reset, stroke and brush before Edit Brush, and the rotation reads Rotate ahead of its angle. Each state dump's top_bar_rows.row_1.breaks and row_2.breaks name the two elements every break stands between.
